newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firm in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firm in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat firmed in tight cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices squeezed up by a scarcity of sellers, traders said.

The price paid to producers for March wheat rose $1 to $142. April cash maize was unchanged at $98 in a slow market devoid of novelty. May soybeans firmed $3 to $250 on rising Chicago prices and concern over the Brazilian crop. Soybean turnover was moderate. March sunflower seed was steady at $212, with prices suppported by firm soybeans.
